caption:
Not a single leaf falls without Allah knowing it

Allah alone holds the keys of the unseen. He knows what is in the land and sea, and not even a leaf falls without His knowledge. Whatever you carry today, it is not hidden from Him.

Surah Al-An'aam 6:59

Save this for the day you feel no one sees what you carry

#allahknows #theunseen #surahanam #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: He alone has the keys of the unseen; no one knows them except Him. He knows what is in the land and sea. Not a leaf falls without His knowledge, nor a grain in the darkness of the earth, nor anything moist or dry, but is [written] in a Clear Record (Surah Al-An'aam 6:59)
theme: Allah knows all / not a leaf falls
